title: Evaluate alert rules, then wire delivery
carries: Delivery decision: webhook sink only (ops has moved off e-mail, nothing may send mail).
info alerts are dashboard-only and are never delivered.
why_not_in_repo: Session 1 builds the rule evaluator, which is sink-agnostic, so its code does not show where alerts go. The decision was stated in session 1 only; the repository ships both sinks and the dispatch signature offers both transports, so delivering everything everywhere looks natural.

learn: Decision: alert delivery goes through the webhook sink only because ops has moved off e-mail. Nothing should send mail, so never call the email sink.
Decision: info severity alerts are only for the dashboard and are never delivered anywhere. Only warning and critical are delivered.
stub.recall_query: alert delivery decision webhook sink email info severity
